items.consecuencia: Its blended price on OpenRouter goes from free to $1.5 per million tokens.

items.consecuencia: Its blended price on OpenRouter goes from $1 to free.

items.what: Alfa Lab stops offering its cheapest Alfa Retira rate on OpenRouter ($0.5 input and $0.5 output per million tokens). The cheapest it has left, which already existed, is $1 input and $1 output.

items.consecuencia: Its cheapest blended price on OpenRouter goes from $0.5 to $1 per million tokens.

items.what: Alfa Lab adds a cheaper Alfa Nueva rate on OpenRouter: $0.5 input and $0.5 output per million tokens. The previous one ($1 input and $1 output) is still available.

items.consecuencia: Its cheapest blended price on OpenRouter goes from $1 to $0.5 per million tokens.

items.what: Alfa Lab cuts the price of Alfa Baja on OpenRouter: input from $3 to $1 and output from $3 to $1 per million tokens.

items.consecuencia: Its blended price on OpenRouter goes from $3 to $1 per million tokens.

items.consecuencia: Alfa Uno (Alfa Lab, 158.4) versus Sino Dos (Sino Lab, 152.9). A few ECI points do not equate to months of lag.

items.consecuencia: AA index 68: 6.1 points behind the best closed model (Eps Cerrado). Rank 9 of 11. Blended price $1.25 per million tokens. Of the 3 models with a similar AA index (±2 points of its 68), 1 costs less; the cheapest is Eta 2, at $1.2.

items.what: Theta Sin API (Alfa Lab) appears scored on Artificial Analysis with 72.4 points, still without a public API: it is not on OpenRouter.

items.porque: it is a new model and enters the top 20 of the AA index (rank 4 of 11)

reglas: The best open-weight or closed model on the Artificial Analysis index changes, with the same index version and a margin of at least 1 point.
Artificial Analysis changes the version of its index.
The observatory’s assessment of an AI 2027 milestone changes.

A new model (including one that AA scores before it has a public API), or one that receives its first AA score, enters the top 20 of the AA index. Its later arrival on OpenRouter does not count again.
A top-20 model on the AA index publishes open weights.
The lab itself changes its price on OpenRouter by at least +50% or −33% (blended price), makes it free or starts charging for it. Withdrawing or adding a rate does not count.
The AI Race: a new best model on Epoch’s ECI, a new METR data point, a new MirrorCode record, a gap that changes by at least 1 ECI point, or power, chips or revenue that change by at least 10%.
The most used model on OpenRouter over the last 7 days changes.

reglas: The best open-weight or closed model on the Artificial Analysis index changes, with the same index version and a margin of at least 1 point.
Artificial Analysis changes the version of its index.
The observatory’s assessment of an AI 2027 milestone changes.

A new model (including one that AA scores before it has a public API), or one that receives its first AA score, enters the top 20 of the AA index. Its later arrival on OpenRouter does not count again.
A top-20 model on the AA index publishes open weights.
The lab itself changes its price on OpenRouter by at least +50% or −33% (blended price), makes it free or starts charging for it. Withdrawing or adding a rate does not count.
The AI Race: a new best model on Epoch’s ECI, a new METR data point, a new MirrorCode record, a gap that changes by at least 1 ECI point, or power, chips or revenue that change by at least 10%.
The most used model on OpenRouter over the last 7 days changes.
